info.title: Kiwix Server
info.description: kiwix-serve 3.8.2 的查询接口（端点与参数出处：kiwix-tools docs/kiwix-serve.rst）。全部只读（GET），无鉴权：服务只在插件网络里，适配器之外只有核心。

get.summary: Look up page title suggestions in one book
get.description: Suggestions (JSON array) for a partially typed page title, matched against the page titles of the given ZIM file.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Name of the ZIM file (the book's `name` metadata, as listed by the entries tool).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Return suggestions starting from this index (default 0).

get.summary: Search for pages inside one book
get.description: Full-text search in the given ZIM file. The result is the search results page (HTML) listing matched articles.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Name of the ZIM file to search (legacy single-book parameter; at least one book selector is mandatory for /search).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Return results starting from this index (default 0).

parameters.name: pageLength
parameters.description: Maximum number of results in the response (default 25, capped at 140).

get.summary: Get a random article from one book
get.description: Redirects to a randomly selected article page of the given ZIM file; the HTTP client follows the redirect and returns the article (HTML).

get.summary: List the books in the library
get.description: Paginated OPDS feed (Atom XML) of the ZIM files in the library, optionally filtered. Each entry carries the book's id (urn:uuid), name, title, language, size and description.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Return entries starting from this index (default 0).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries (default 10; -1 for all; 0 returns none but reveals the total via the feed's totalResults).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Filter by language, comma-separated 3-letter codes (e.g. `zho,eng`); an entry matches when any of its languages is listed.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only entries whose title or description contains this text.

200.description: An OPDS acquisition feed (Atom XML) of matching books.
